lead_raw_text:
The structure of Eu4Pr4Sn8 (EuPrSn2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies Eu and Pr centers each coordinated by 12 Sn neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Sn centers have 12 geometric neighbors (4 Eu, 4 Pr, 4 Sn), all at 3.3744 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Sn polyhedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Eu and Pr polyhedra.
